findings.highlight: you can do so at the end of the week
findings.evidenceJa: 「あ、アンサンブルの記事チェックの件でしょうか？それでしたら週明けには…」
findings.explanation: Haruki says the Ensemble article check will be ready at the beginning of next week. The English says the end of the week, reversing the business deadline across the weekend.
findings.japanese:
「あ、アンサンブルの記事チェックの件でしょうか？
それでしたら週明けには…」
findings.todokanai: "Ah, could it be about the article inspection at Ensemble? In that case, you can do so at the end of the week…"

findings.highlight: I swear she just came back to her residence.
findings.evidenceJa: 「あれぇ？　おかしいなぁ…つい先ほど滞在先に伺ってきたばかりなんですが」
findings.explanation: Haruki says he himself has just visited Kazusa at the place where she is staying, baiting Miyoko into revealing the office has lost contact with her. The English says Kazusa just returned to her residence, reversing the visitor and inventing movement by Kazusa.
findings.japanese:
「あれぇ？　おかしいなぁ…
つい先ほど滞在先に伺ってきたばかりなんですが」
findings.todokanai: "Huh? That's strange… I swear she just came back to her residence."

findings.highlight: Do you take me for someone who's self-employed…?
findings.explanation: After Suzuki claims Haruki will write, photograph, edit, print, and sell the issue alone, he asks what kind of doujinshi operation she thinks this is. The English replaces the specific self-published-zine production joke with the unrelated employment category 'self-employed.'
findings.todokanai: "Do you take me for someone who's self-employed…?"

findings.highlight: It'll fester, and pus will gush out of your wrist.
findings.evidenceJa: 「化膿するぞ？腐りきって、手首からぽとっと落ちるぞ？」
findings.explanation: Haruki grotesquely jokes that Kazusa's hand will suppurate, rot through, and drop off at the wrist with a plop. The English instead has pus gush out of the wrist, changing the threatened loss of her pianist's hand into discharge from it.
findings.japanese:
「化膿するぞ？
腐りきって、手首からぽとっと落ちるぞ？」
findings.todokanai: "The wound will become infected, you know? It'll fester, and pus will gush out of your wrist."

findings.highlight: Because her attitude is so half-assed, I have no choice but to accept any fastballs she throws at me.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな中途半端な態度だから、ど真ん中の剛速球を受け止めることなんかできない。
findings.explanation: Because Haruki's own attitude is so half-hearted, he cannot catch Kazusa's blazing fastball straight down the middle—her declaration that he matters more than her hands. The English assigns the half-heartedness to Kazusa and says Haruki has no choice but to accept the pitches, reversing both subject and result.
findings.japanese:
そんな中途半端な態度だから、
ど真ん中の剛速球を受け止めることなんかできない。
findings.todokanai: Because her attitude is so half-assed, I have no choice but to accept any fastballs she throws at me.

findings.highlight: "My new project has been decided on. They're going to let me write an entire issue."
findings.evidenceJa:
『新しいプロジェクトが決まった。
雑誌を一冊、任せてもらえることになった』
findings.explanation: Haruki has been entrusted with an entire magazine issue, which includes editing; the English says he will write an entire issue — The larger conversation repeatedly states his editorial role and broad production duties.
findings.japanese:
『新しいプロジェクトが決まった。
雑誌を一冊、任せてもらえることになった』
findings.todokanai: "My new project has been decided on. They're going to let me write an entire issue."
